tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Everything sits on this; in Phosphor it is the tube's black, in Paper a cool off-white.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, device tiles, dialogs, table header rows. One step up from surface; separated by `line`, never by shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, code blocks, the log pane, table zebra rows. One step below surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders between regions, table rules, card edges. Decorative only: do not rely on it to carry meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: input edges, the active tab underline, the meter's frame, selected rows. 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and data, on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`. Pale phosphor, never pure white, so headings do not bloom.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, timestamps, hints, table captions, on any surface. 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, disabled labels, dividers drawn as glyphs (`/`, `·`). Below 4.5:1 by design: never for content a person must read.

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: The one hue. Primary action fill, the active indicator, links, the online dot, and emphasised data as text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `phosphor-soft`. Spend it on the thing the screen is for.

tokens.name: phosphor-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind `phosphor` text or `ink` text: selected rows, the active tab in a segmented control, a soft badge.

tokens.name: phosphor-dim
tokens.usage: Phosphor at half brightness: hover edge on quiet buttons, the meter's filled segments at rest, the frame of a focused card. 3:1 on `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: on-phosphor
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a `phosphor` fill (the primary button's label). Dark on the bright Phosphor fill, white on the deep Paper fill; never literal white or black.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse video: the fill of a fault badge, a selected menu row, the cursor block. Alias of `ink`.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an `inverse` fill. Alias of `surface`.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, on any surface. Alias of `phosphor`; underline on hover only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring of this colour, offset 2px, on every focusable control. Alias of `phosphor`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The backdrop under a dialog.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Space Grotesk for the few words that name a screen. Tight leading, slight negative tracking, medium weight; never bold.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The product name on the cover and sign-in; nowhere inside the app.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One per screen, in the toolbar.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and dialog titles, a device's name on its card.

groups.name: Terminal
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for everything else: body, data, labels, controls. Tabular by nature, so columns of sizes and timestamps line up without effort.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Table cells, device ids, paths, log lines. Use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: A device's identifier, a column's key value, a count.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, table headers, badge text, tab names. Always uppercase (`text-transform: uppercase`).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Footnotes, version strings, hints under inputs. Set in `ink-muted`.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Dense by default: an admin screen shows a fleet, not a brochure.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a dot and its word, between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps: between buttons in a group, badge padding, meter segment pitch.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, input padding, gap between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards in a grid, toolbar side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps, dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters, the space under a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The gap above a new page region; the cover's inset.

radius.note: Square is the default. Corners are cut, not rounded.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs, the meter, inputs. The house shape.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and badges: just enough to take the edge off anti-aliasing.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and the cursor caret only. Never on a button.

stroke.note: Borders do the work shadows do elsewhere.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Every border: cards, inputs, rules, the meter frame.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: The active tab underline, the focus ring, the dialog's top rule.

shadow.note: No drop shadows. The only shadow is a phosphor glow, and it only appears on the primary action and on keyboard focus.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Behind a `phosphor` fill at rest (the primary button, the online dot on a card). In Paper it collapses to a 1px edge.

tokens.name: glow-strong
tokens.usage: The focus ring's halo and a primary button's hover. Never on more than one element at a time.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs. Named so a consumer can see the choice was made.
